_comment: Themed circuits (v3_content_plan PART A + v6_party_gimmicks_circuits.md). Curated arena rotations with a difficulty arc. Level ids resolve to res://levels/<id>.json. Two rotation shapes: (1) ORDERED loop -- a plain `levels` array (string ids), played in authored order, looping (the shipped format). (2) RANDOM DRAW -- an optional `pool` array of {id, tier} + `draw_count` + `draw_mode`:'shuffle': each play SHUFFLES the pool, takes draw_count, and tier-sorts the drawn slice mild->wild (~20 authored / ~10 drawn per play, v6 3.2/3.3). `tier` (1-3) is the within-circuit wildness rank used only to order the drawn subset. Top-level `order` is the UNLOCK chain (v6 4.2): circuit N+1 unlocks when N is WON or played 3x (Settings progression).

the_foundry._comment: Molten-factory gimmick circuit (v6_party_gimmicks_circuits.md §3.1 row 3). Signature mechanics: crusher + destructible_block + spinning_hammer + the COLLAPSING-ARENA finale, all validated Batch-1. First authored wave = 4 arenas on the flagship void_is_floor shape, tier-sorted into a mild->wild micro-arc each match (tier 1 press-row crusher on-ramp -> tier 2 destructible + multi-hazard -> tier 3 last-one-flying meltdown finale). FOLLOW-UP: grow the pool toward the v6 ~8-20 target (more crusher/hammer/destructible variants + a second collapsing layout). Unlock chain (top-level `order`): unlocks by WINNING high_wire OR the pity path (Settings progression, v6 §4).

mayhem_mile._comment: The WILD gimmick-BRAWL circuit (v6). RANDOM-DRAW demo: a ~12-stage pool; each play shuffles + draws 6 + tier-sorts them into a mild->wild micro-arc, so every round is a fresh escalating set. tier 1 = single readable hazard on-ramp; tier 2 = a bigger single-family threat; tier 3 = multi-hazard chaos + the collapsing-arena finale. Every stage is a real BRAWL stage (off-screen-kill through-line, flight-required void gaps, symmetric telegraphed dodgeable hazards). The 8 gimmick stages are joined by 4 reused base/hazard stages to reach the ~10-12 pool.
